limits: Development server on localhost; not an online deployment verification.
Short functional checks include video instrumentation; use a separate sustained run for performance conclusions.
Mobile tests emulate touch and viewport on the desktop GPU; no physical phone was measured.
The 120-second sustained replay test is intentionally excluded from this functional suite.
